stage: Candidate-theorem verification, defined before the new numerical checks
model: Balanced null binary logistic choice with intercept, independent standard Gaussian contrasts, constant frozen predictorq and population auxiliary risk
simulation: Draw original GaussianX and BernoulliY. Couple predictors and nested dimensions on each draw. Compare the empirical moment-support event with the independently evaluated binomial/chi-square formula. These are MonteCarlo checks, not collected human responses.
population_numeric_checks: Targets with outcome mean0.3,0.5,0.7 and slope-moment norm0,0.5,0.95,1.05,1.5 times the Gaussian support radius. Solve interior cases by adaptive numerical integration; verify negative recession rays outside.

nonnull_extension_before_simulation.target: Verify the candidate calibration-dependent phase for bounded frozen one-index predictors. Constant-predictor exact finite-label checks remain a separate output.

novelty_status: Unproven; exact candidate formula and proportional boundary are assessed separately from classical convex-support and separation results.
stopping_rule: Retain every cell and discrepancy. Numerical agreement does not establish priority or full finite-pool/real-DCE applicability.
